scopePolicy: Preserve the supplied curriculum objective and number/position ranges. Keep kindergarten; report catalog conflicts rather than silently raising grade or weakening the objective.

contributionDefinitions.meaningful_context: Orient the child and establish why this topic is interesting or useful.
contributionDefinitions.explanation_and_modeling: Introduce essential concepts or model a method before dependent practice. An explanatory display can make a complete contribution without assessment.
contributionDefinitions.supported_investigation: Let the child actively explore or try an idea in a form appropriate to the topic and available capabilities.
contributionDefinitions.supported_practice: Give supported opportunities to perform the selected objective tasks.
contributionDefinitions.application: Use an idea in a fresh example, problem or decision appropriate to the objective.
contributionDefinitions.closing_independent_assessment: Offer fresh opportunities to demonstrate selected objectives before hints or model answers. Identify what is not assessed.

assumptions: User confirmed kindergarten to expose curriculum/catalog gaps. Non-reader and 15-minute session remain pilot assumptions. Objective text is user supplied; IDs and evidence criteria are tester-authored. No external curriculum IDs were looked up.

objective.text: Represent numbers 16-19 as ten ones plus additional ones using manipulatives

evidenceDefinitions.teen-represent-16-19-e1: Builds a target in 16-19 with ten ones and 6-9 additional ones.
evidenceDefinitions.teen-represent-16-19-e2: Makes the ten-ones group and extra ones distinguishable through learner manipulation.
